title: Positive finite scaling for the bounded AC1015 attributed INSERT graph
scope: The explicitly opted-in AC1015 predeclared INSERT chain accepts positive finite X/Y/Z scale factors. All prior graph, named-block, default extrusion, 2D attribute, identity, ownership and frame-receipt restrictions remain. Zero, negative and nonfinite scales still fail atomically. No public object or virtual layout changes.
authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 section 20.4.9 specifies R2000 INSERT flags 3, 2, 1 and 0 for unit, uniform, X-unit and general scale encoding. The existing encoder selects those forms by exact stored-double equality and writes non-default values with RD/DD.

physicalSources.method: From-scratch ezdxf 1.4.5 DXF -> ODA File Converter 27.1.0 AC1015 DWG -> ODA DXF. tools/audit_ac1015_insert_scale.py authors and checks the source graph via LibreDWG 0.14 and ODA DXF via ezdxf. No DWG/DXF fixture was added.

rotatedPopulated.graph: LibreDWG validates block record, BLOCK/ENDBLK, ordered named-block LINE/CIRCLE/ARC and model chains, INSERT, ATTRIB and SEQEND ownership and handle roles. ODA DXF preserves attribute tags, values, rotations and positions. ezdxf computes the transformed 3D block LINE from (1,2,3)-(4,5,6) as (1.7320508075688779,10.196152422706632,12)-(2.4282032302755105,20.99038105676658,24), matching before/after ODA output.

generatedOutput.method: Focused generated AC1015 tests exercise unit, uniform, X-unit, nonuniform, fractional and near-unit scales; compare exact typed native DWG readback; validate immutable parent/child/SEQEND receipts; and verify same-writer rollback/retry for zero, negative, infinity and NaN. A separate test emits a rotated (2,3,4) INSERT with nonempty 3D named block content.
generatedOutput.flags: LibreDWG verbose output independently reports flags 3, 2, 1 and 0 for the generated unit, uniform, X-unit and general cases respectively.
generatedOutput.peer: LibreDWG peer checks four generated nonunit profiles and the rotated populated graph, including block references, chain roles and attribute positions/angles. ODA converted all six generated outputs to DXF without error files; tests/dwg_legacy_insert_scale_oda.py checks four profiles and the populated graph using ezdxf.
generatedOutput.nearUnitLimit: The native DWG typed reader preserves nextafter(1,2), 1, nextafter(1,0) exactly. ODA DXF text rounds the first value to 1.0 and LibreDWG JSON prints unit values, so external exact-bit equivalence is not claimed for this near-unit case.

validation: Run each binary with --keep, then tests/dwg_legacy_insert_chain_libredwg.py and tests/dwg_legacy_block_content_chain_libredwg.py against retained scratch DWGs: five peer profiles PASS
ODA converts retained generated DWGs to DXF; tests/dwg_legacy_insert_scale_oda.py verifies the four nonunit and one populated profile: PASS
tools/audit_ac1015_insert_scale.py verify MODE SOURCE.dwg OUTPUT.dxf /opt/homebrew/bin/dwgread: uniform, xunit, nonuniform and populated PASS
limits: Evidence does not establish arbitrary scale rendering in native CAD applications or near-unit exactness after third-party DXF conversion.
Negative, zero, nonfinite, MINSERT, nondefault extrusion, out-of-profile attribute metadata, unsupported graph roles and general DWG parity remain outside this bounded route.
All DWG/DXF source and output drawings are scratch-only and no fixture was added.
